text.p: DeltaPoint Inc on Monday said the company's stock has been delisted from the Nasdaq SmallCap Market, effective today.
"We are disappointed by the Nasdaq's decision to impose additional equity listing requirements that resulted in delisting," John Ambrose, chief executive officer, said in a statement."
But he noted the company, which provides advanced Website creation and management software, is happy about the progress of its core Internet tools business.
DeltaPoint recently launched QuickSite 2.5, a commerce enabled Website tool for small office/home office use.
The company is beta-testing with a private-branded version of QuickSite for International Business Machine Corp's IBM World Distributor, IBM's electronic commerce service.
DeltaPoint raised $2.15 million in December 1996 through a convertible debt offering, it said.
